checks.message: Boundary is explicitly provisional, traceable, and not presented as an official redline.
All three required key areas are present as provisional constraints and linked to the source package.
Five adjacent land-use polygons are generated by clipping shared cut lines and cover the submitted site.
Known geometry metrics are recomputed in EPSG:4548 from the submitted layers.
Narrative, five figures, reports, visual pages, and drawings have paired language files.
Visual pages are offline static HTML with local images and metrics matching metrics.json.
Official boundary, ownership, regulatory controls, municipal capacity, traffic, fire, and heritage attachments remain pending professional confirmation.
